summary: At the cited protected revision, the supplier /2 reader decodes into PortableJournalEntry.PortableSupplierAdmissionDraft without persisted schema identity. StageSupplier rereads that versionless entry for compare-and-swap (CAS), and the writer always emits fsgg.portable-execution-supplier-journal/2. Adding a /3 reader alone would therefore lose the original version across read/update. The source correction in FS-GG/.github issue #4516 comment 6204264375 refines a pending source-only proposal; it is not an accepted implementation or receiving-owner decision. Proposed compatibility requires retaining the persisted version through read, CAS and write: preserve execution/host /1 and wire-only supplier /2 bytes; explicitly choose /3 only for fresh originals, and keep /3 even with empty pending or WireV1. Refuse version changes, native pending/history in /2, and fresh-original replacement at an occupied key before writing. Keep the existing root/key/lock. Existing supplier journal regressions cover restart with durability Unknown, revision/effect-phase refusal preserving bytes, and pending challenge preservation or exact consumed/abandoned ledger entry; they do not establish the proposed /3 behavior. Frozen /2 read/CAS and empty-pending /3 roundtrips are required future compatibility checks. This finding extends coordination/portable-host-journal-boundary without changing its lifecycle finding. Receiving authority remains unresolved; native proof, ACK, handoff, durability and original effects remain held.
title: Supplier journal version must survive read and compare-and-swap before a proposed v3 extension
